                Use it in the app

                A theme you buy here also dresses Lightning on your PC and phone. Three steps, once per profile.

                1. Buy it here. It shows under Owned.
                2. On the theme’s card, press Get app code.
                3. In the app, open Settings › Appearance, paste the code and press Unlock. Do this once: your profile’s other devices unlock by themselves.

                Another profile needs its own unlock, at a quarter of the price. Unlocking needs Lightning 1.5.4 or later, which adds Unlock a theme you bought.

                Payments and refunds

                Top-ups and cosmetic purchases are final. No discretionary refunds are offered at this time. Required legal rights and manual review of duplicate transfers, incorrect payments or failed delivery remain available.

                Copy your account email into the transfer note, then confirm the date, amount and InstaPay address you paid from. Cotton is added after the owner confirms the money arrived.
